## Plugin reference

- Description: Rename a conversation by hand: RenameConversationAction, the item action a conversation list contributes to its rows (the sidebar's Queue and History, in the row's ⋯ menu), opening a dialog that writes the conversation's own title as the user's. Renaming a conversation, every host's half: PUT /api/conversations/:id/title writes the conversation's own title and marks it as the user's (titleByUser), so no generated title replaces it and the conversation lists name the row by it whatever their title setting.
- Web:
  - Uses:
    - `infra/endpoints.EndpointError`
    - `infra/endpoints.getEndpointErrorMessage`
